verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS remote-access and IT-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no first-party feature for exporting all user data in open formats. The Web API and the 'audit log and API' entry are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented full-data export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
